_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: White vinyl fence gate aligned squarely between two posts with black hinges and latch
figures.caption: Set the opening from the finished fence line, posts, grade, and swing clearance before the hardware is tightened. A gate needs a square, well-supported opening rather than a stronger latch alone.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Exterior gate hinge attached to a sturdy wood post with a diagonal brace behind it
figures.caption: Hinges and latch hardware need solid support at the posts. Keep enough adjustment for seasonal movement and a clean latch, especially where wind can load the open gate.

figures.alt: Weathered fence post with decay at grade beside a braced replacement post and footing excavation
figures.caption: After rain, check the bottom rail and posts as well as the gate panel. A gate that drags often needs grade, post, or hinge correction instead of more force at the latch.
